sections.text: Beginners mix up money words and then make bad decisions. You only need six: revenue, cost, profit, cash, price, and margin. This lesson is about money words without mba. Revenue, cost, profit, cash, price, margin. Do not treat this as theory only. Treat it as a move you can run this week. By the end, you should be able to act without waiting for a perfect plan.

sections.text: Revenue is the money customers pay you. If Maya sells one invoicing guide for seventy-nine dollars, revenue from that sale is seventy-nine dollars. Remember the objective: define revenue vs profit vs cash. Write the idea in your own words before you move on. Name one concrete next action you can finish in under an hour.
